**1 — Scene:** A mixed meal of creamy dressed green salad with croutons, breaded meat strips (likely chicken), and two small pieces of pepperoni pizza.

**2 — Vessel:** A rounded-square dinner plate, approximately 26 cm across. Using a 26 cm circular approximation gives an area of **3.14 × 13² ≈ 530 cm²**.

**3 — Items:** Lettuce, chopped salad vegetables, croutons, creamy dressing, a little grated cheese, breaded meat strips, and pepperoni pizza. Pizza cheese and sauce are included in the pizza estimate.

**4–6 — Area, volume, and weight:** Food covers approximately **85%** of the plate. Dressing and grated cheese overlap the salad rather than occupying additional plate area.

| Item | Plate area | Gross volume calculation | Bulk density | Estimated weight |
|---|---:|---|---:|---:|
| Lettuce | 35% | 186 cm² × 3 cm = 558 ml | 0.18 g/ml | 100 g |
| Chopped vegetables | 4% | 21 cm² × 1.5 cm = 32 ml | 0.60 g/ml | 19 g |
| Croutons | 3% | 16 cm² × 1.5 cm = 24 ml | 0.35 g/ml | 8 g |
| Breaded meat strips | 20% | 106 cm² × 1.4 cm = 148 ml | 0.95 g/ml | 141 g |
| Pepperoni pizza | 23% | 122 cm² × 1.3 cm = 159 ml | 0.95 g/ml | 151 g |
| Creamy dressing | Coating | About 200 cm² × 0.15 cm = 30 ml | 1.0 g/ml | 30 g |
| Grated cheese | Scattered topping | About 20 cm² × 0.5 cm = 10 ml | 0.50 g/ml | 5 g |

Coverage check: **35 + 4 + 3 + 20 + 23 = 85%**. Croutons and loosely grated cheese use lower bulk densities because of their porous or loose structure.

**7 — Energy:** Lettuce 20, vegetables 30, croutons 400, breaded meat 260, pizza 280, dressing 450, and grated cheese 400 kcal per 100 g. These contribute approximately **20 + 6 + 32 + 367 + 423 + 135 + 20 = 1,003 kcal**.

**8 — Sanity check:** Approximately **454 g and 1,000 kcal** is plausible for this mostly covered plate. The pizza, breaded meat, and creamy dressing supply most of the energy. A reasonable uncertainty range is roughly **800–1,200 kcal**, especially given the uncertain meat preparation and dressing quantity.
